meta.promptText: Which brand's formal shirts should I buy for men in India?

response.text:
If you want **formal shirts for men in India**, I’d shortlist these brands:

| Brand | Best for | Typical budget |
|---|---|---:|
| **Van Heusen** | Best overall for office wear | ₹900–₹2,500 |
| **Louis Philippe** | Premium, polished look | ₹1,200–₹3,500+ |
| **Raymond** | Classic, sophisticated formalwear | ₹1,200–₹3,500 |
| **Arrow** | Traditional corporate/formal style | ₹1,200–₹3,500 |
| **Park Avenue** | Good value for everyday office wear | ₹800–₹2,000 |
| **Allen Solly** | Modern office / less conservative | ₹900–₹2,500 |
| **Peter England** | Budget-friendly work wardrobe | ₹700–₹1,800 |
| **Blackberrys** | Sharper, slimmer premium fit | ₹1,200–₹3,000 |


Recent 2026 comparisons consistently put Van Heusen, Louis Philippe, Raymond, Arrow, Park Avenue, Allen Solly and Peter England among the stronger mainstream choices. [midvey.com](https://midvey.com/blogs/news/top-10-best-formal-shirt-brands-in-india-for-2026?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

### My recommendation

**🥇 Best overall: Van Heusen**  
If you're buying 3–5 shirts for regular office use, I'd start here. Good balance of appearance, fit, comfort and price. Current listings include solid formal shirts around ₹840–₹1,300. [dressingschool.com](https://dressingschool.com/picks/formal-shirts/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

### [Van Heusen Men Solid Formal]()
*₹840*

**🥈 Best premium: Louis Philippe**  
Choose this if you want a more refined, senior-professional appearance. Their cotton formal shirts are particularly good for important meetings, presentations and client-facing work.

### [Louis Philippe Men Cotton Fit Formal Shirt]()
*₹2,669*

**🥉 Best value: Park Avenue**  
A very good choice if you need several shirts without spending too much.

### [Park Avenue Men Slim Fit Formal Shirt]()
*₹879*

### If you're building a basic wardrobe

I'd buy:
- **2 white** — essential
- **2 light blue** — extremely versatile
- **1 light grey**
- **1 subtle blue/white stripe**
- **1 pale pink or lavender**, if your workplace allows it

For genuinely formal office wear, prioritize **100% cotton or good cotton-rich fabric, solid colours, and a fit that isn't excessively slim**. Fit matters more than paying extra for the brand. [dressingschool.com](https://dressingschool.com/picks/formal-shirts/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**If you tell me your budget per shirt (₹500 / ₹1,000 / ₹1,500 / ₹2,000 / ₹3,000+) and your body type (slim/average/heavy), I can narrow it down to the 3–5 best shirts to buy right now.**
